users.title: Users and roles
users.description: Server-side role grants keyed by the identity provider subject. Granted roles are unioned with the roles in the person's verified token, so faculty and deans can be promoted here even when the university IdP sends no role claim.
users.newSubHint: The IdP sub (Keycloak user id, Supabase uid). The row is created with the student role.
users.empty: No users yet. A user appears after their first verified request, or when you add one by subject.

dean.title: Institution dashboard
dean.lede: Every learner's completed encounters for your organisation, aggregated on the server from the hash-chained event log. Learners appear as masked handles; nothing here is a learner's private ego-data.
dean.privacy: Aggregate view for {{org}}. Handles are masked; chain integrity is verified on every load.

kpi.learnersHint: Distinct learners with a completed encounter in the window
kpi.encountersHint: Completed encounters received by the server
kpi.dxAccuracyHint: Share of encounters with the correct final diagnosis
kpi.safetyMissHint: Encounters with a safety-critical timing miss or unchecked allergies
kpi.brierHint: Calibration error across scored domains, lower is better
kpi.atRiskHint: Flagged by safety, competence, diagnosis or calibration rules

risk.title: At-risk learners and remediation
risk.subtitle: Learners the server flagged from their own recorded encounters. Assigning a remediation case closes the loop: the assignment completes when the learner's next encounter for that case is received.
risk.none: No learner meets an at-risk rule in this window.
risk.noSub: This learner is not in the roster yet, so no assignment can be addressed to them.
risk.loopNote: Assignments and completions are visible to faculty on the Faculty page.

grid.title: Cohort competency grid
grid.subtitle: Each learner's mean competence per domain, banded. The band word and fill level carry the meaning; colour is secondary.
grid.caption: Learners by competency domain
grid.empty: No completed encounters in this window yet.

bands.title: Band distribution by domain
bands.subtitle: How many scored encounters fell in each band, per domain.

calibration.heading: Aggregate calibration
calibration.headingSub: Decisiveness against measured competence, aggregated per domain across the cohort.
calibration.title: Calibration by domain
calibration.subtitle: Mean absolute gap between confidence and competence, and how many encounters ran over-, well- or under-confident.

export.title: Accreditation export (server)
export.subtitle: A de-identified JSON file built on the server from the same chained rows: masked handles, per-domain bands, outcome flags and the chain head for audit.
export.failed: The export could not be generated.

fallback.title: Showing your on-device records only
fallback.body: The institution data source did not answer ({{error}}). Cohort analytics need the AcuDx gateway; the panels below use this browser's own records.
fallback.forbidden: Your current identity is not allowed to read cohort data. Sign in with an institution account that holds the dean role.

dean.footer: Generated for {{name}} from server data for {{org}}.

faculty.title: Faculty workspace
faculty.lede: Review authored cases and flagged encounters, manage your roster and assign cases. Every grading override is co-signed and recorded on the server.
faculty.forbidden: Your current identity is not allowed to use the faculty workspace. Sign in with an account that holds the faculty role.
faculty.unavailable: The faculty API did not answer ({{error}}).

review.pointsHint: Optional summative points override for this case.
review.pointsError: Enter a whole number between 0 and {{max}}.
review.notCredentialed: Only a credentialed teaching role (faculty, dean or admin) can co-sign.
review.needOverride: Set at least one band or a points value to override.

roster.heading: Roster ({{count}})
roster.empty: No learners in your organisation yet.
roster.name: Learner

assign.title: Assign a case
assign.caseIdHint: The case the learner must complete; the assignment closes when their encounter for it arrives.
assign.everyone: Assign to every learner in the organisation
